views.title: Isometric
criteria: Head hub with three equal OpenBeam legs
Cube-corner splay: legs mutually orthogonal, 120° in top view

views.title: Front (−Y)
criteria: Legs pitch downward from hub at cube-corner splay
Beam ends seated in U-cradles against the stop

views.title: Top (+Z)
criteria: Three legs at 120° around hub (cube-corner top view)
Equal radial reach; no leg missing a socket

views.title: Right (+X)
criteria: Leg along +X cradle seated at stop (flush to stop face)
Beam T-slot orientation matches bolt / section-center axis
